description: This Java class, ProductController, is a Spring MVC Controller responsible for managing product-related operations in the admin backend of an e-commerce system. It handles actions such as displaying product details, creating and editing products, duplicating products, removing product images, and managing product categories, including listing and associating products with categories. The controller interacts with various services to perform CRUD operations and data handling related to products, categories, manufacturers, tax classes, and images.

classes.name: ProductController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller class for managing product administration functionalities such as creating, editing, duplicating, and associating products with categories within the e-commerce application's admin backend.

methods.name: displayProductEdit
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the product editing page for an existing product identified by 'id'.

methods.name: displayProductCreate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the new product creation page.

methods.name: displayProduct
methods.description: Private helper method to prepare and display the product form for both creation and editing modes.

methods.name: saveProduct
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a product, including validation, processing images, and managing related entities.

methods.name: duplicateProduct
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of an existing product, copying its attributes, descriptions, images, and relationships, but not SKU or reviews.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a product image by its ID, ensuring proper authorization.

methods.name: displayAddProductToCategories
methods.description: Displays a page allowing assigning the product to categories.

methods.name: pageProductCategories
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of categories associated with a specified product, for AJAX-based pagination.

methods.name: deleteProductFromCategory
methods.description: Removes the association of a product with a category, returning success or failure status.

methods.name: addProductToCategory
methods.description: Adds a product to a specified category, updating the associations.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set the current menu context for UI rendering.
